title: Compare Party pad, scaled touch and blank area
platforms: Android engine interpreter on host Linux; native Android untested
changes: Document pad selection and confirmation, a scaled-world touch and a blank-area touch in the same EUR Party gallery on fork and upstream.
validation: All six isolated host engine scenarios pass their observation assertions; pad selects member 1 on both, scaled touch selects member 1 only upstream, and blank touch opens member 0 on both. Four protected input hashes remain unchanged.
limitations: One EUR scene and an explicitly supplied host world rectangle; no complete state/timing equivalence, actual Android layout calculation, JNI, native blocks, emulator or device. Builds emitted unused-code warnings.
